title: LotteryMC
description: A plugin that allows you to easily run raffles among the players on your server.
body:
**LotteryMC** allows you to easily run raffles among the players of your server!

### Available commands:
- **/lotterymc about** Shows a little description.
- **/lotterymc raffle (true/false) (number of winners)** Runs the raffle. True option will show the participants in the chat at the beginning, false will hide them.
- **/lotterymc github** Shows a link to author's github.

### Usage example:
- /lotterymc raffle true 3
